overlaps.rationale: Departure is the act of leaving, whereas departure lounge is the airport waiting area before leaving.
A waiting room is a generic room where service users wait; a departure lounge is specifically an airport area for passengers awaiting departure.
A boarding gate is the airport location where passengers board, while a departure lounge is the waiting area before boarding.
